title: Gravity, Galaxies, and Cosmology as Vacuum Inflow
abstract: This volume reinterprets gravitational and cosmological measurements within the Volume-Particle framework (VP, also denoted AQD), in which the physical vacuum is a space-filling, jammed packing of identical rigid quanta and light is its elastic wave. paper_abstract_source:
This volume reinterprets gravitational and cosmological  measurements  within the
Volume-Particle framework (VP, also denoted AQD), in which the physical vacuum is a
space-filling, jammed packing of identical rigid quanta and light is its elastic wave.
A single mechanism underlies everything that follows: every material particle
 annihilates  vacuum quanta at a fixed rate, and the resulting depletion drives a
permanent inflow of the surrounding medium. From this one premise we develop, with
 no omitted logical steps  and with a runnable simulation attached to every claim,
the following Earth- and cosmos-scale consequences: gravity as the momentum of absorbed
inflow; planetary orbits and Kepler's laws; axial spin and tidal locking; galactic
rotation curves and the acceleration scale a₀; “dark matter” as a vacuum deficit
that simultaneously gravitates, lenses, and goes dark; and a non-expanding, lattice-optics
cosmology. The  foundational  constants of the framework—most importantly the
per-nucleon annihilation rate 3π⁴—are imported from the companion physics volume
(DOI \href{https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17932566}{ 10.5281/zenodo.17932566 }) and are not re-derived here; this volume is devoted to their
large-scale consequences. Throughout, each result is explicitly labelled as
 degenerate  (a re-description that makes the same predictions as standard theory),
 distinguishing  (derivable only in this framework, e.g. a₀=cH₀/2π), or
 conflicting  (a falsifiable tension; the sharpest case, vacuum dispersion, is reframed in
Ch 2). We make no claim
that is not either reproduced by an attached simulation or explicitly flagged as open.
